text:
Casey (People Ops): dropping a tiny, copy-first bundle for mid-cycle goal checks and self-reviews. super short so teams actually paste it into invites/forms.
Rina (Eng Manager): can I get a 1-line calendar blurb and a one-paragraph self-review devs can paste?
Casey (People Ops): calendar blurb: 'Mid-cycle check (20m): share progress, call out one blocker, agree one concrete support action.'
Casey (People Ops): 1-paragraph self-review (copy/paste):
Role & scope: [one line]. Top outcomes this cycle: 1-2 bullets with links/metrics. Key lesson or tradeoff: one sentence. Blocker I need help with: one sentence. Growth ask for next cycle: one sentence.
Dev (SWE): nice. micro-agenda for 20m 1:1?
Casey (People Ops): 20m micro-agenda: 3m headline metric/link, 7m blockers & context, 7m manager commits/decisions (who/when), 3m career pulse.
Ava (Product): what's the shortest peer prompt we can send async?
Casey (People Ops): async peer prompt: 'In 1-2 bullets: 1) one concrete thing they did that helped you ship (link if possible), 2) one small improvement suggestion.' 48h suggested.
Rina (Eng Manager): calibration shorthand we can paste into notes?
Casey (People Ops): calibration card (paste): Impact H/M/L + 1-line evidence; Ownership H/M/L + 1-line note; Risk G/A/R + 1-line reason.
Dev (SWE): any sample filled example to show tone?
Casey (People Ops): example: Role: Backend SWE (inference). Outcomes: reduced 95p latency 25% (dash). Blocker: infra quota for stress tests. Growth: lead cross-team perf review next sprint.
Rina (Eng Manager): can we version this so changes are visible?
Casey (People Ops): version v1.0-compact. If you adapt, post new-tag + 1-line summary here.
CheckBot: Reminder: schedule midpoint nudges with `/perf nudge create --when midpoint --offset -14d --team @team` or see /docs/perf/reminders.
Ava (Product): will add to our team handbook and post v1.0-pm if we tweak for PMs.
Casey (People Ops): thanks! small ask: if you change format (bullets vs paragraph), add "format: bullets" in the header so calibrators know.
